title: A fact id the planner shortened is made whole when exactly one fact of the brief starts with it
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A fact id the planner shortened is made whole when exactly one fact of the brief starts with it.

tests: a plan that cites every fact by its first 8 digits fails R02 everywhere, and passes once the ids are made whole
a cite that two facts start with, or none, stays as written; a plan with whole ids comes back as the same object
